scope: media production only; not runtime tests

cases.title: Product identity
cases.acceptance: Film remains about Métis, note-taking, keyboard invocation and useful assistance; no Notchview feature transplant.

cases.title: Source and claims
cases.acceptance: Every apparent product behavior has actual evidence or visible concept/reconstruction disclosure.

cases.title: Keyboard continuity
cases.acceptance: Shown shortcut is configured; show/hide does not imply meeting end or microphone consent.

cases.title: Hindsight proof
cases.acceptance: Cross-session claim depends on actual upstream-backed retain/recall and current source, not seeded conversation.

cases.title: Approval/result truth
cases.acceptance: No fake authorization, success, pointer action, send, latency or readiness.

cases.title: Original branding and assets
cases.acceptance: Approved Métis identity and rights-checked assets; no redistributed font binaries.

cases.title: Storyboard
cases.acceptance: Scene timecodes are contiguous and total target duration; capture/claim IDs and reading holds resolved.

cases.title: Motion and readability
cases.acceptance: Rendered frames and transition samples pass contrast/overflow/focus/phone preview inspection.

cases.title: Audio
cases.acceptance: Rights/source documented; actual mix checked; no clipping or fake product voice proof.

cases.title: Render
cases.acceptance: Actual composition checks, exports, probe metadata and playback review completed.

cases.title: Formats and opening
cases.acceptance: Deliberate reframed cutdowns, correct poster, no frame-zero flash or sync drift.

cases.title: Handoff/privacy
cases.acceptance: Editable files, reproducible commands, sanitized registers, truthful blocked status; no unauthorized publication.
